_note: Monthly rules and calendar refresh (BETA_CONVERSATION_SPEC 3.3; app/research/rules_refresh.py). targets: per policy file, the items to check: glob is a path of keys and list indexes where * matches every key or index (keys starting with _ are skipped), fields are the values the model reads from the item's source, sources names the item's key holding its URL (a string or a list; the first https URL is read). Items sharing a URL are checked with one page read and one model call (one compact JSON object per source; its output limit is the researcher role's max_tokens in model_roles.json); each counts against PAI_RULES_REFRESH_MAX_CALLS. A source whose page cannot be read (HTTP error, timeout) or whose model call fails (output limit, 400, 5xx, timeout) is listed as unread and the refresh goes on. The worker queues a refresh only when the last one is PAI_RULES_REFRESH_INTERVAL_DAYS old and it has been up PAI_RULES_REFRESH_MIN_UPTIME_MIN minutes. Only a page on the source's own site is read (a redirect elsewhere is unread); PDFs are read as text. A value becomes a proposed diff only when it differs from the current value and its quote is on the page (line breaks ignored), is a real passage (quote_rules: min_chars characters, min_words words) and states the new value: a number as a number, a month of a *months field by a name in month_names, text as itself, every element of a list. Nothing is applied: scripts/apply_refresh.py applies a reviewed proposal. validation_tests are what apply_refresh runs before keeping a change.
